changelog: Standalone app — completely separate from the download website, with its own player UI
Adaptive isolation engine: every song is analyzed with FFT and the strongest strategy is picked per track (center extraction / center blend / frequency focus)
Cleaner vocals: 3-band mid extraction with presence boost; sharper karaoke with bass return and deeper mono notch
Full player: library, search, playlists, favorites, queue, 5-band EQ, sleep timer, playback speed
WAV export saves straight to your phone (Music/VocalPure) — no download-page round trip
